Paragraph: "By men the enemies are to be assessed... for, they move in disguise and distrustful enemies will trounce the complacently self-assured ones that relax in their own self-confidence on any possible occasion..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Risk of lethal vulnerability due to complacency.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Sugreeva details the danger of covert enemies taking advantage of relaxed, trusting individuals.
Outcome/Resolution: He justifies his heightened vigilance as a necessary safety measure.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Chidra-Prahara (Exploitation of weak points/loopholes by hostile foes)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: A seeker must remain vigilant against subtle internal enemies that attack during moments of spiritual complacency.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Risk management psychology: balancing healthy self-preservation with over-generalized suspicion.
